featured_reviews.name: Pratiksha Pingle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been a customer of Kulkarni Opticians since 1997, almost 30 years. Even with so many options available today, I continue to buy my contact lenses from them because of their excellent service, expertise, and trustworthiness.

We recently visited them for my daughter's contact lens needs, and she too had a wonderful experience.

Highly recommended for both contact lenses and spectacles. If you're looking for an optician you can trust, Kulkarni Opticians is the place to go.

featured_reviews.name: Santosh Sanap
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best Optical & Eyewear Store Experience!
I had an amazing experience at this optical store! They have a fantastic collection of stylish frames, premium sunglasses, and top-quality lenses. The staff was extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and guided me through the perfect choice based on my face shape and vision needs.

What impressed me most was their precision in eye testing and the speedy delivery of my glasses. The store ambiance is clean, modern, and customer-friendly. Definitely the best eyewear destination for anyone looking for quality, variety, and great service. Highly recommended! ❤️✅️

featured_reviews.name: Sujata Vaze
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been going to Kulkarni opticians for my soft lenses and spectacles for the past 50 years. Very professional and approachable for any eye related issues. Very satisfied with their service.

featured_reviews.name: Sarvesh Shyam Ligam
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst service. I have been their customer for 4 years for both glasses and contact lenses. So i did not take, nor they offer me any written prescription from them which is fine, since they maintain computerised record. But now when I wanted to know my eye powers to make sunglasses outside, only because these people had limited frames, they denied sharing that with me. They kept lying on the call and gave me a number of excuses. I wonder what is the reason for not sharing my own details with me. And then you are not also telling that openly, you are lying!! From next year onwards, I will not go to them, and I will also tell my parents to stop visiting them. Such a pathetic behaviour!!!!
